summary: Consolidation of cyber harassment investigations; transfer of 15 crime cases to Coimbatore Cyber Crime Station; continuation of Crime No. 123/2024 under IPC s.509, TN Harassment of Women Act s.4, IT Act s.67; no merit comment; investigation to proceed expeditiously; reference to prior order in Criminal Appeal No. 1845/2022; breach consequences specified.
legal_provisions_cited: Tamil Nadu Prohibition of Harassment of Women Act, 1998 s.4
final_judgment: Writ petition disposed with directions for investigation consolidation and continuation; chargesheet/closure as per law.
